import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Module
import Mathlib.Tactic

noncomputable section
open Finset
namespace BanditRL.OnlineCumulativePotential

theorem finite_regret_identity {E : Type*}
    (psi loss : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x : ℕ → E) (u z : E)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    let y : ℕ → E := fun t => if t = T then z else x t
    let G : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun t v => psi t v + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), loss i v
    (∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t (y t) - loss t u)) =
      psi (T - 1) u - psi 0 (y 0) +
      (∑ t ∈ range T, (G t (y t) - G t (y (t + 1)))) +
      (∑ t ∈ range (T - 1),
        (psi t (y (t + 1)) - psi (t + 1) (y (t + 1)))) +
      G (T - 1) z - G (T - 1) u

end BanditRL.OnlineCumulativePotential
proof_topology: Expand the inclusive cumulative potential to obtain Gₙ₊₁(v) = Gₙ(v) + ψₙ₊₁(v) − ψₙ(v) + ℓₙ₊₁(v). All operations are ordinary real arithmetic.
For a prefix of n + 1 rounds, retain the last term Gₙ(yₙ₊₁) − Gₙ(u). The one-round case follows by expanding G₀ and cancelling terms.

Extend the identity by one round. Expand each finite sum at its last index and substitute the recurrence for G. The intermediate potential terms cancel; the change from ψₙ to ψₙ₊₁ remains as the explicit regularizer-change summand.
Use T > 0 to set n = T − 1, then substitute y_T = z. This gives the displayed terminal gap without assigning it a sign.
